title: Ursa Wren
description: An unflinching leader and capable warrior, Ursa Wren commanded the Mandalorian forces of Clan Wren. She traveled with Bo-Katan Kryze as they sought Ahsoka Tano's help to liberate Mandalore from the clutches of Maul and fought beside her during the siege of the planet. Ursa Wren also fought the Empire through the dark times; Wren was exiled to Krownest until reconciling with her daughter, Sabine Wren, brought her back into the fight and she rallied under Bo-Katan's leadership once more.
